result.detail: Asana publish page says submit for review needed to make OAuth app available to users in any workspace beyond own org/dev environment. Unsubmitted OAuth apps are for internal/testing. No install/user cap stated. Caveat: manage-distribution page offers "Any workspace" setting letting users from any workspace authorize via URL, with no review mentioned there, so docs conflict. Publish page is the explicit statement. Per-user Personal Access Tokens need no review (not an OAuth app path).
result.quote: Make your app available to users in any Asana workspace, beyond your own organization or development environment
